name: Mirrativ,Inc.
summary: Mirrativ Inc. develops and operates a live streaming platform. Its features include Emomo, an avatar function for creating an alter ego, Ranking, an event ranking users and streams on various metrics, and Live Gaming, which lets streamers and viewers play together during broadcasts. Formerly Emomo Inc., it was renamed in April 2018, formed in 2015 and has its head office in Meguro, Japan.
